name: Prerelease-Alpha
body:
Release created at Tue Oct 13 22:26:56 CST 2026 Synchronize Alpha branch code updates, keeping only the latest version
[我应该下载哪个文件? / Which file should I download?](https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/wiki/FAQ) [二进制文件筛选 / Binary file selector](https://metacubex.github.io/Meta-Docs/startup/#_1) [查看文档 / Docs](https://metacubex.github.io/Meta-Docs/) ## What's Changed * fix: bound doh dials so ones the query gave up on cannot pile up by @Cassian433 in https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/pull/3274 * fix: keep fake-ip allocation state when cloning the pool on reload by @drakeo338 in https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/pull/3283 * chore: update mieru version by @enfein in https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/pull/3304 * fix(listener): mark the embedded shadowsocks listener closed so its accept loop exits by @TokenPLS in https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/pull/3314 * fix: a sub-millisecond URL test is reported as a failure by @TokenPLS in https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/pull/3316 * fix: dialer-proxy cycle check takes quadratic time and memory by @TokenPLS in https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/pull/3315 ## New Contributors * @Cassian433 made their first contribution in https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/pull/3274 * @drakeo338 made their first contribution in https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/pull/3283 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MetaCubeX/mihomo/compare/v1.19.32...Prerelease-Alpha
